summary_1line: Satyavati arranges for Vyasa to impregnate Ambika to continue the Kuru line; frightened by his appearance, she closes her eyes, leading to the birth of the blind Dhritarashtra.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a lamplit chamber, the princess Ambika shuts her eyes in fear as the wild-haired sage Vyasa with blazing eyes and matted locks approaches her bed.
Satyavati anxiously questions Vyasa outside the chamber while the sage foretells that the child born will be mighty yet blind.
Satyavati leads the richly dressed princess into a perfumed sleeping chamber and instructs her to await the sage who will give her a child.
